# Frontend Feature Docs

One standardized doc per frontend feature. Each covers: overview, screens/routes, a diagram, components, state and forms, GraphQL operations, validation, and the main files. The contextual save-bar rules live in [../../AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

| Feature | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| [abandoned-carts](abandoned-carts.md) | Marketing list of idle registered-customer carts: promo, date-scoped KPIs, Linear-quiet customer/product views and filter chips, reminder drawer (discount optional), hide, draft order, CSV of the current page. Automatic recovery emails live under Settings → Abandoned cart reminders. |
| [ads](ads.md) | Marketing → Ads shell: dashboard KPIs (empty until live reporting), draft campaign list/detail, Meta/Google/TikTok/Snapchat integration scaffolding (localStorage demo connect), audience placeholder. No OAuth or GraphQL ads API yet. |
| [ai](ai.md) | Streaming AI chat assistant with tool cards, conversation history, and rich-text editor rewrite via Groq. |
| [analytics](analytics.md) | Profit-first sales dashboard: KPI deltas, sales-over-time chart, gross→net→profit breakdown (COGS/fees/margin), per-shop currency, CSV export, supporting cards. Sales are every order except cancelled and failed, minus settled refunds. A "Sales by channel" section (online store, Telegram, WhatsApp, draft orders) shows a share ribbon, one tile per channel and a stacked chart over time. The UTM card is now "Sales by traffic source". |
| [reports](reports.md) | Self-serve report builder: pick dimensions × measures, run, and view a totaled results table. |
| [attribution](attribution.md) | Marketing attribution report: revenue by channel/source/campaign with a bar chart and new-vs-returning breakdown. |
| [customer-analytics](customer-analytics.md) | Customer retention cohorts, lifetime value, repeat rate, and top customers. |
| [auth](auth.md) | Documents login, register, OTP, magic-link, password-reset, email-verify flows with token/cookie architecture. |
| [balance](balance.md) | **Deprecated (D26).** Shop ledger + request-payout dialog (`createWithdrawal`). Not a bank payout. |
| [bank-transfers](bank-transfers.md) | Settings → Payments (methods + Saudi accounts) and order-detail receipt review (approve/reject). No standalone queue. |
| [collections](collections.md) | Documents the source-based collection editor: list, create/edit screen, conditions and exclusions, live item preview, save-bar wiring. |
| [coupons](coupons.md) | Merchants create, filter, edit and delete four types of discount coupons with contextual save bar. |
| [customers](customers.md) | Manage shop customers via create, list, edit, and delete screens backed by GraphQL contact mutations. |
| [files](files.md) | Content > Files media library: Shopify-style list/grid, search/filter/sort, replace-in-place and copy-link row actions, and an image editor with Save / Save-as-new. |
| [insights](insights.md) | Proactive AI insight panel on the analytics overview: severity-tagged cards (low stock / sales drop / trending) read from the back-end detector engine, with dismiss. |
| [instagram](instagram.md) | Settings → Instagram: connect the shop's Instagram account through Zernio (Connect fetches Zernio's authorization URL; the server receives the redirect and returns the merchant with `?instagram=connected` or `?instagram=error&reason=`), check its health, disconnect, and set the assistant's DM and comment switches and keywords. The status is the server's verdict only — no client-side "connected" fallback. Posts and KPI cards still show sample content. |
| [inventory](inventory.md) | Multi-location stock management with transfers, purchase orders, suppliers, and bulk editing. |
| [inventory-analytics](inventory-analytics.md) | Stock-health report: inventory value at cost/retail, sell-through, out-of/low/dead-stock counts, an ABC revenue breakdown, and top-mover / dead-stock / slow-mover tables. |
| [notifications](notifications.md) | Header bell (unread badge, SSE push, polling fallback), the `/notifications` page (paged history with All/Unread filter, per-row mark read/unread + delete, per-type delivery preferences), and the Settings → Notifications email console. |
| [negotiation](negotiation.md) | AI price negotiation policy card on the product form, plus the Analytics → Negotiations outcomes report with its trend, by-product and by-strategy breakdown; gated on `ai.negotiation`; quiet not-on-plan state. |
| [orders](orders.md) | Orders list and detail: server-side search and filter-bar chips, status transitions, Shopify-style Create order / draft flow (Products + Payment + Notes/Customer/Markets/Tags), fulfillment with tracking, refunds, and bank-transfer receipt review on the detail page. |
| [product-relations](product-relations.md) | Vendor card for linking products as related, upsell, cross-sell, or bundle items. |
| [plan](plan.md) | `/plan/[shopSlug]` and three tabs under it, a top-level route with no dashboard chrome: **Overview** (status, the billing period drawn to scale, what the plan includes), **Plans** (tier cards and the capability-by-tier comparison), **Usage** (allowances, window totals, and the call-by-call ledger), **Billing** (payment method, invoices, cancel/resume). Self-serve upgrades through Stripe Checkout plus the hosted billing portal. Also owns the sidebar's plan card and the **Plan pane of the settings overlay**. |
| [products](products.md) | Vendor product catalogue: list, create, edit with save-bar, variants, metafields, bulk actions, and bulk import (CSV or a scan of the merchant's old store). |
| [returns](returns.md) | The RMA queue: customer-raised returns, the allowed status transitions, and the confirmed "received" step that issues the refund. |
| [reviews](reviews.md) | Customer reviews for the shop: rating average and distribution, server-side rating/product/search/sort filters, photos, and reporting a review to the platform. |
| [segments](segments.md) | Customer segmentation with ShopifyQL editor, AI generation, preview, and analytics insights tab. |
| [shipments](shipments.md) | Order detail → Shipments: what left which warehouse, its tracking history, its boxes, and what the carrier billed. Grouped by fulfillment because a split order ships from more than one location. |
| [shipping](shipping.md) | Settings → Shipping: who delivers (merchant-managed vs a carrier, with per-shop carrier credentials and branch mapping) above what the customer pays (zones, rate bands, and the diagnostics that surface how `selectShippingRule` actually picks one). Connecting a carrier changes neither. |
| [settings](settings.md) | Full-screen shop settings overlay. General, Plan, Payments, Abandoned cart reminders, Notifications, Shipping, Taxes, WhatsApp, Telegram, Domains, Policies and Shein are built; the other sections show placeholders. |
| [telegram](telegram.md) | Settings → Telegram: two bots under two headings, the shop's first. The **shop's own customer bot** is a BotFather token pasted once — no save bar, no mask, no `touched` set, because the server never returns the token in any form; the bot's `@username` is what says which bot is connected. Connect asks Telegram whose token it is before anything is stored, a refused webhook is shown in Telegram's own words above the form, and Disconnect goes through a confirm dialog because reconnecting needs the token again. Once the bot is live, its card carries the WhatsApp screen's customer assistant switch and, under a live assistant, **Take orders in the chat** (confirmed when turned on, gated on `ai.agent.checkout`). The **Zaydak assistant** card mints a one-time `t.me` link that lives in component state only (never cached, never re-shown; whoever opens it binds their Telegram to this account), with consent above the button; it is shop-scoped like the bot above it, and its Disconnect is a ghost because Connect re-links in a minute. |
| [whatsapp-inbox](whatsapp-inbox.md) | Conversations customers started on the shop's own WhatsApp number, and the box that answers them. **Not the `conversations` inbox with a filter** — a WhatsApp customer has no account and no participant row, so these threads are scoped by shop ownership instead of membership. Renders the three voices apart (customer / AI / merchant), because "what was said in my name while I was not looking" is the question it exists to answer. Replying pauses the assistant, and the screen says so before you type. |
| [whatsapp](whatsapp.md) | Settings → WhatsApp: two numbers under separate headings — the shop's own (connect with a live QR streamed over SSE and never stored, or an 8-character code; status, test send, disconnect) and Zaydak's vendor assistant, which is **never pairable from here**: its handset is enrolled server-side by the shop's own QR scan, so the card shows which phone may write, which store it answers about, and an unlink. Consent is stated before the code appears; the customer AI bot is a separate decision that is **asked** after a successful scan rather than defaulted on. |
| [shops](shops.md) | Shop picker, create-store wizard, and settings edit screen with contextual save bar. |
| [country-profiles](country-profiles.md) | Declared business country on Create Store; caps drive payments/shipping UI. |
| [signup](signup.md) | The /register wizard: email, personal info, OTP, then the create-store type-chip screen, ending in a signed-in vendor dashboard. |
| [stock-notifications](stock-notifications.md) | Read-only vendor card listing pending back-in-stock email subscribers on the product edit page. |
| [tags](tags.md) | Documents the tags feature: list, search, create, edit, and delete bilingual product labels via modal dialogs. |
| [storefront-templates](storefront-templates.md) | Theme library on Online Store → Themes and the full-screen `/theme-preview/[templateId]` route. The four templates (doughn, hullo, drip, rail) render from `@repo/storefront-templates`. Preview opens the sample. A custom theme is a conversation on Settings → WhatsApp. The library does not apply a theme. |
| [theme-editor](theme-editor.md) | Online Store theme editor: homepage section tree, mock preview, inspector, draft/publish via a swappable repository (localStorage today). |
| [targets](targets.md) | Sales goals as radial attainment gauges with pacing charts, projection, and a save-bar create/edit form. |
| [webhooks](webhooks.md) | Vendor self-service HTTPS webhooks with HMAC signing, delivery history, and one-shot secret reveal. |

34 features documented. Every file follows the same template.
